ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.11 targets the JobGiver search spikes measured in long-run V0.4.10.1 logs. Supported custom-global GenClosest calls now use pressure-adaptive nearest-first spatial ordering: the candidate threshold and ring granularity tighten only when measured frame pressure rises, while low-pressure frames remain conservative. Candidate membership is unchanged. Reachability.CanReach, WorkGiver validators, reservations and final Jobs remain main-thread authoritative. Very large immutable position snapshots may use an opportunistic worker assist, but V0.4.11 never waits for a late worker: if the micro-budget expires, the main thread immediately performs the cheap integer fallback while the late worker result is discarded. V0.4.6/V0.4.7 hauling accelerators, bounded path shadow validation, V0.4.8 slow JobPackage tracing and Butter++ logical-tick barriers are retained.
